// wireDownload is the wire form of Download: streams travel as handles.
type wireDownload struct {
	Size int64  `json:"size"`
	Body uint32 `json:"body"`
}

func downloadFromWire(w wireDownload, conv *streams.Conv) Download {
	return Download{
		Size: w.Size,
		Body: conv.Reader(w.Body),
	}
}

func downloadPtrFromWire(w *wireDownload, conv *streams.Conv) *Download {
	if w == nil {
		return nil
	}
	v := downloadFromWire(*w, conv)
	return &v
}

func downloadToWire(v Download, conv *streams.Conv) wireDownload {
	return wireDownload{
		Size: v.Size,
		Body: conv.ReaderHandle(v.Body),
	}
}

	return &w

// blobWriteResponse writes a JSON response to plugin memory.
func blobWriteResponse(p *extism.CurrentPlugin, stack []uint64, resp any) {
	respBytes, err := json.Marshal(resp)
	if err != nil {
		blobWriteError(p, stack, err)
		return

	respPtr, err := p.WriteBytes(respBytes)
	if err != nil {
		stack[0] = 0
		return

	stack[0] = respPtr
}

func blobWriteError(p *extism.CurrentPlugin, stack []uint64, err error) {

		Error string `json:"error"`

	respBytes, _ := json.Marshal(errResp)
